description: Image Description: A serene pastoral scene features a group of black cows resting on a lush green grassy field. The cows are lying down, some facing the camera while others are turned slightly away, appearing calm and relaxed. In the background, there is a large stone church with a prominent tower and arched windows, suggesting a historic or rural setting. The church is partially framed by trees, including a large leafy tree on the right side of the image and a few smaller ones near the building.
